scope: One genuine PUN OfflineMode room and one spawned network owner. Confirmed-capture snapshots are explicit fixtures; outcome events use PUN RaiseEvent and its actual sender. Does not establish live 2–4-client transport, late joins, Master migration, remote latency or a physical Android device.

checks.name: Actual PUN offline room has an authoritative Master
Existing spawner creates one real owned network character
Existing TakeDamage and barrier outcomes share one authoritative heart count
Master-confirmed capture locks the network owner and opens its UI
checks.detail: locked=True, ui=True, localChallenge=True, playerEnabled=True, capsuleEnabled=True, state=Caught, phase=BarrierChallenge, cinematic=False

checks.name: Authoritative avatar receiver clamps even an owner-authored escape packet
Capture enforcement still holds when the movement script is disabled on a replica
Existing five-field owner serialization sends the anchor and stopped animation flags
Actual sender event is rejected when host development testing is disabled
PUN dispatch rejects payload identity injection and stale serials

Real owner cannot resolve another actor's challenge
PUN-authenticated sender produces one accepted failure, rejecting duplicate/opposite results

Room checkpoint carries canonical anchor, processed outcome and absolute per-actor health
